question: How many models does each car maker produce? List maker full name, id and the number.

sql.W1:
SELECT 
    cm.Name AS CarMakerName, 
    cm.Id AS CarMakerId, 
    COUNT(ml.ModelId) AS NumberOfModelsProduced
FROM 
    car_makers cm
JOIN 
    model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
GROUP BY 
    cm.Id
sql.W2:
SELECT CarMakers.FullName, CarMakers.Id, COUNT(model_list.Model) AS NumberOfModelsProduced
FROM car_makers AS CarMakers
JOIN car_names AS CarNames ON CarMakers.Id = CarNames.MakeId
JOIN model_list AS ModelList ON CarMakers.Id = ModelList.Maker
GROUP BY CarMakers.Id
sql.W3:
SELECT CarMakers.FullName, CarMakers.Id, COUNT(model_list.Model) AS NumberOfModelsProduced
FROM car_makers AS CarMakers
JOIN car_names AS CarNames ON CarMakers.Id = CarNames.MakeId
JOIN model_list AS ModelList ON CarMakers.Id = ModelList.Maker
GROUP BY CarMakers.Id
sql.W4:
SELECT car_makers.FullName, car_makers.Id, COUNT(car_names.Model) AS NumberOfModels
FROM car_makers
JOIN countries ON car_makers.Country = countries.CountryName
JOIN car_names ON car_makers.Id = car_names.MakeId
GROUP BY car_makers.Id
sql.E:
SELECT CarMakers.Name AS MakerName, CarMakers.Id, COUNT(model_list.Model) AS NumberOfModels
FROM car_makers AS CarMakers
JOIN model_list ON CarMakers.Id = model_list.Maker
JOIN car_names AS CarNames ON CarNames.MakeId = CarMakers.Id
GROUP BY CarMakers.Id

question: What is the name of the winner who has won the most matches, and how many rank points does this player have?

sql.W1:
SELECT winner_name, SUM(winner_rank_points) AS total_rank_points
FROM matches
JOIN players ON matches.winner_id = players.player_id
GROUP BY winner_name
ORDER BY total_rank_points DESC
LIMIT 1
sql.W2:
SELECT p.winner_name, r.ranking_points 
FROM matches m 
JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id 
JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id 
WHERE m.match_num IN (
    SELECT MAX(match_num) 
    FROM matches 
    GROUP BY winner_id
)
ORDER BY r.ranking_points DESC LIMIT 1
sql.W3:
SELECT p.winner_name, r.ranking_points 
FROM matches m 
JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id 
JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id 
WHERE m.match_num IN (
    SELECT MAX(match_num) 
    FROM matches 
    WHERE winner_id = p.player_id 
    GROUP BY winner_id
)
ORDER BY r.ranking_points DESC LIMIT 1
sql.W4:
SELECT 
  w.winner_name AS winner_name,
  SUM(r.ranking_points) AS total_ranking_points
FROM 
  players w
JOIN 
  matches m ON w.player_id = m.winner_id
LEFT JOIN 
  rankings r ON w.player_id = r.player_id
GROUP BY 
  w.player_id
ORDER BY 
  total_ranking_points DESC
LIMIT 1
sql.E:
SELECT winner_name, SUM(winner_rank_points) AS total_rank_points
FROM matches
JOIN players ON matches.winner_id = players.player_id
GROUP BY winner_name
ORDER BY total_rank_points DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What are the names of the winner and loser who played in the longest match?

sql.W1:
SELECT winner_name, loser_name 
FROM matches 
WHERE (winner_id, loser_id) IN (
    SELECT winner_id, loser_id FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id, loser_id ORDER BY LENGTH(score) DESC LIMIT 1
)
sql.W2:
SELECT T1.winner_name, T1.loser_name 
FROM matches AS T1 
JOIN players AS T2 ON T1.winner_id = T2.player_id 
JOIN players AS T3 ON T1.loser_id = T3.player_id 
WHERE T1.minutes = (SELECT MAX(minutes) FROM matches)
sql.W3:
SELECT T1.winner_name, T1.loser_name 
FROM matches AS T1 
JOIN players AS T2 ON T1.winner_id = T2.player_id 
JOIN players AS T3 ON T1.loser_id = T3.player_id 
WHERE (T1.best_of, T1.draw_size) IN (SELECT max(best_of), max(draw_size) FROM matches GROUP BY best_of, draw_size)
sql.W4:
SELECT T1.winner_name AS Winner, T2.loser_name AS Loser 
FROM matches AS T1 
JOIN players AS T2 ON T1.winner_id = T2.player_id 
WHERE LENGTH(T1.score) = (SELECT MAX(LENGTH(score)) FROM matches)
sql.E:
SELECT winner_name, loser_name 
FROM matches 
WHERE (winner_id, loser_id) IN (
    SELECT winner_id, loser_id FROM matches GROUP BY winner_id, loser_id ORDER BY LENGTH(score) DESC LIMIT 1
)

question: What are the names and ranks of the three youngest winners across all matches?

sql.W1: SELECT winner_name, winner_rank FROM matches ORDER BY winner_age ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, r.winner_rank 
FROM players p 
JOIN matches m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id 
JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id 
WHERE r.ranking_points IN (
    SELECT MIN(ranking_points) 
    FROM rankings 
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT winner_id 
        FROM matches 
        ORDER BY winner_age ASC LIMIT 3
    )
)
ORDER BY r.ranking_points DESC

SELECT 
    w.first_name, 
    w.last_name, 
    r.ranking_points AS rank
FROM 
    matches m
JOIN 
    players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id
JOIN 
    rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE 
    m.year IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT year FROM matches
    )
ORDER BY 
    r.ranking_points ASC
LIMIT 3
sql.W4:

    w.winner_name AS name, 
    r.ranking_points AS rank
FROM

JOIN

question: Find the first name, country code and birth date of the winner who has the highest rank points in all matches.

SELECT T1.winner_name AS 'First Name', T2.ioc AS 'Country Code', T3.birthdate AS 'Birth Date'
FROM matches AS T1
JOIN players AS T2 ON T1.winner_id = T2.player_id
JOIN players AS T3 ON T1.loser_id = T3.player_id
WHERE T1.winner_rank_points IN (
    SELECT MAX(winner_rank_points)
    FROM matches
)
ORDER BY T1.winner
sql.W2:
SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code, p.birth_date 
FROM players p 
JOIN (
    SELECT w.player_id, MAX(ranking_points) AS max_points 
    FROM players w 
    JOIN rankings r ON w.player_id = r.player_id 
    GROUP BY w.player_id
) t ON p.player_id = t.player_id
sql.W3:
SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code, p.birth_date 
FROM players p 
JOIN (
    SELECT w.player_id, MAX(ranking_points) AS max_points 
    FROM players p JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id 
    GROUP BY w.player_id
) t ON p.player_id = t.player_id AND p.ranking_points = t.max_points

FROM players p

    FROM players w 
    JOIN matches m ON w.player_id = m.winner_id 
    JOIN rankings r ON w.player_id = r.player_id 
    GROUP BY w.player_id
) t ON p.player_id = t.player_id
sql.E:
SELECT T1.winner_name AS 'First Name', T2.ioc AS 'Country Code', T3.birthdate AS 'Birth Date'

JOIN players AS T2 ON T1.winner_id = T2.player_id

        WHEN SUM(killed) > 0 THEN 'Killed'

        WHEN SUM(injured) > 0 THEN 'Injured'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS injury_situation
FROM

    caused_by_ship_id IN (

            id
        FROM 
            ship
        WHERE

    s.tonnage = 't'

    d.cause

) T ON S.semester_id = T.semester_id

SELECT Singer_Name, SUM(Total_Sales) AS Total_Sales FROM (
    SELECT S.Singer_Name, SUM(S.Song_ID * T.Total_Sales) AS Total_Sales
    FROM singer S
    JOIN song T ON S.Singer_ID = T.Singer_ID
    GROUP BY S.Singer_Name
) AS SubQuery
GROUP BY Singer_Name
sql.W2:
SELECT s.Name, SUM(song.Sales) AS Total_Sales
FROM singer s
JOIN song ON s.Singer_ID = song.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Name
sql.W3:
SELECT s.Name, SUM(song.Sales) AS Total_Sales
FROM singer s
JOIN song ON s.Singer_ID = song.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Name
sql.W4:
SELECT s.Name, SUM(songs.Sales) AS Total_Sales
FROM singer s
JOIN song songs ON s.Singer_ID = songs.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Name
sql.E:
SELECT s.Name, SUM(song.Sales) AS Total_Sales
FROM singer s
JOIN song ON s.Singer_ID = song.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Name

question: Which customers ordered products from the Beverages category?

sql.W1:
SELECT DISTINCT Customers.CustomerName 
FROM Orders 
JOIN OrderDetails ON Orders.OrderID = OrderDetails.OrderID 
JOIN Products ON OrderDetails.ProductID = Products.ProductID 
JOIN Categories ON Products.CategoryID = Categories.CategoryID 
JOIN Suppliers ON Products.SupplierID = Suppliers.SupplierID 
WHERE Categories.CategoryName = 'Beverages'
sql.W2: SELECT DISTINCT T1.CustomerID, T1.CompanyName FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID JOIN `Order Details` AS T3 ON T2.OrderID = T3.OrderID JOIN Products AS T4 ON T3.ProductID = T4.ProductID WHERE T4.CategoryID IN (SELECT CategoryID FROM Categories WHERE CategoryName = 'Beverages')
sql.W3: SELECT DISTINCT T1.CustomerID, T1.CompanyName FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID JOIN `Order Details` AS T3 ON T2.OrderID = T3.OrderID JOIN Products AS T4 ON T3.ProductID = T4.ProductID WHERE T4.CategoryID IN (SELECT CategoryID FROM Categories WHERE CategoryName = 'Beverages')
sql.W4:
SELECT T1.CompanyName, T2.CategoryName 
FROM Customers AS T1 
JOIN Orders AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID 
JOIN `Order Details` AS T4 ON T3.OrderID = T4.OrderID 
JOIN Products AS T5 ON T4.ProductID = T5.ProductID 
JOIN Categories AS T2 ON T5.CategoryID = T2.CategoryID 
WHERE T2.CategoryName = 'Beverages'
sql.E:
SELECT DISTINCT C.CustomerID, C.CompanyName
FROM Customers C
JOIN Orders O ON C.CustomerID = O.CustomerID
JOIN `Order Details` OD ON O.OrderID = OD.OrderID
JOIN Products P ON OD.ProductID = P.ProductID
WHERE P.CategoryID IN (SELECT CategoryID FROM Categories WHERE CategoryName = 'Beverages')
